verdict.rationale: Bun's homepage publishes measured install timings: bun v1.4 at 0.21s against npm v12.0.2 at 4.45s. These numbers back the docs' 'up to 25x faster' and homepage 'up to 30× faster' claims, and a community comment reports measured 10–20x faster isolated installs on Windows. Missing for 10: published benchmark methodology or reproducible benchmark setup, independent third-party benchmark corroboration of the headline install figures, and reconciliation of the differing 25x vs 30x claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims

citations.quote: make your installations up to 25x faster
Isolated installs are a significant performance improvement on Windows (10x, sometimes 20x faster installs)
